# Froot Framework — Complete LLM & Agent Reference Manual

> Package: \`frootjs\` | CLI: \`create-frootjs\` | GitHub: https://github.com/orbitnorth/froot

---

## 1. CLI Scaffolding Reference (\`create-frootjs\`)

### Machine-Readable CLI Schema
Run \`npx create-frootjs --schema\` to output the complete JSON specification of options and templates.

### Non-Interactive Command Arguments
| Flag | Description | Values / Examples |
|---|---|---|
| \`-t, --template <name>\` | Architecture template | \`mvc\`, \`modular\`, \`streaming\`, \`websocket\`, \`openapi\`, \`fullstack\`, \`minimal\` |
| \`--db <orm>\` | Database & ORM integration | \`none\`, \`drizzle\`, \`prisma\` |
| \`--docker\` / \`--no-docker\` | Containerization files | Generates multi-stage \`Dockerfile\`, \`docker-compose.yml\`, \`.dockerignore\` |
| \`--linter <tool>\` | Code quality setup | \`none\`, \`biome\`, \`eslint\` (includes Prettier) |
| \`--test <tool>\` | Unit test suite | \`none\`, \`vitest\`, \`node\` (node:test) |
| \`--agent\` / \`--no-agent\` | AI agent documentation | Generates \`AGENT.md\` and \`.cursorrules\` (defaults to \`true\`) |
| \`--pm <manager>\` | Package manager | \`pnpm\`, \`npm\`, \`yarn\`, \`bun\` |
| \`-y, --yes\` | Non-interactive mode | Bypasses all CLI prompts |

---

## 2. Core Framework API (\`frootjs\`)

### Instance Creation & Sub-Routers
\`\`\`ts
import { Froot } from 'frootjs';

// Root application
export const app = new Froot();

// Feature sub-router
export const apiRouter = new Froot();
apiRouter.get('/users', (c) => c.json([{ id: '1', name: 'Alice' }]));

// Mount sub-router under prefix
app.route('/api', apiRouter);
\`\`\`

### Routing Methods
\`\`\`ts
app.get(path, handler);
app.post(path, handler);
app.put(path, handler);
app.delete(path, handler);
app.patch(path, handler);
\`\`\`

### Context API (\`c\`)
- \`c.req.raw\`: Native standard \`Request\` object.
- \`c.req.param(name)\`: Extract path parameter (e.g. \`/users/:id\` -> \`c.req.param('id')\`).
- \`c.req.query(name)\`: Extract query parameter (e.g. \`?limit=10\` -> \`c.req.query('limit')\`).
- \`await c.req.json<T>()\`: Parse JSON body.
- \`await c.req.text()\`: Parse text body.
- \`c.req.header(name)\`: Retrieve request header.
- \`c.req.cookie(name)\`: Retrieve parsed cookie.
- \`c.json(data, status?)\`: Send JSON response.
- \`c.text(text, status?)\`: Send text response.
- \`c.html(html, status?)\`: Send HTML response.
- \`c.redirect(url, status?)\`: Send redirect response.
- \`c.header(key, val)\`: Set response header.
- \`c.status(statusCode)\`: Set HTTP status code.

### Error Handling & 404
\`\`\`ts
app.onError((err, c) => {
  console.error(err);
  return c.json({ error: 'Internal Server Error', message: String(err) }, 500);
});

app.notFound((c) => {
  return c.json({ error: 'Not Found', path: c.req.path }, 404);
});
\`\`\`

---

## 3. Real-Time Streaming & SSE (\`frootjs/streaming\`)

\`\`\`ts
import { streamSSE, streamText, sleep } from 'frootjs/streaming';

app.get('/api/telemetry', (c) => {
  return streamSSE(c, async (stream) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      await stream.writeSSE({
        event: 'metric',
        data: JSON.stringify({ timestamp: Date.now(), cpu: Math.random() * 100 }),
      });
      await sleep(1000);
    }
  });
});

app.get('/api/chat', (c) => {
  return streamText(c, async (stream) => {
    const tokens = ['Hello', ' ', 'world', ' ', 'from', ' ', 'Froot!'];
    for (const token of tokens) {
      await stream.write(token);
      await sleep(100);
    }
  });
});
\`\`\`

---

## 4. WebSockets & Pub/Sub Hubs (\`frootjs/ws\`)

\`\`\`ts
import { upgradeWebSocket, createHub } from 'frootjs/ws';

const hub = createHub();

app.get('/ws', upgradeWebSocket((c) => ({
  onOpen(ws) {
    hub.subscribe('general', ws);
    hub.broadcast('general', JSON.stringify({ event: 'join' }));
  },
  onMessage(ws, message) {
    hub.broadcast('general', message);
  },
  onClose(ws) {
    hub.unsubscribe('general', ws);
  },
})));
\`\`\`

---

## 5. OpenAPI 3.1 & Interactive Docs (\`frootjs/openapi\`)

\`\`\`ts
app.openapi({
  info: {
    title: 'Enterprise API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    description: 'Auto-generated OpenAPI 3.1 documentation',
  },
  docsPath: '/docs',
});
\`\`\`

---

## 6. Server-Rendered JSX (\`frootjs/jsx\`)

\`\`\`tsx
import { jsx } from 'frootjs/jsx';

function Layout({ children }: { children: any }) {
  return (
    <html>
      <head><title>Froot SSR</title></head>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}

app.get('/', (c) => {
  return c.html(
    <Layout>
      <h1>Server-Rendered Native JSX</h1>
    </Layout>
  );
});
\`\`\`

---

## 7. Zero-Port In-Memory Testing

\`\`\`ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { app } from '../src/app.js';

describe('HTTP Endpoints', () => {
  it('GET / responds 200', async () => {
    const req = new Request('http://localhost/');
    const res = await app.fetch(req);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  });
});
\`\`\`
